denominator: 30 deliberately selected clauses; not a random ERPNext sample
proofBatch: The bounded_one_create results come from scripts/bench_proofs.py run at commit 3a050b2f2460ff703b2f2d75a7145d66f34a4a1a, an earlier head of this branch. The generated declarations and profile are unchanged since; later commits changed only error handling and output labels.

rules.requirement: A purchase order line quantity is positive
rules.limit: Bounded, one-create profile only (norn.bench.one-create/1: empty store, one object, one create step, numeric inputs in [-3, 4]). 3 of the law's 10 proof goals are eligible and discharged; the other 7 (law_semantics, open_boundary) stay unknown, so this is not a whole-law proof. The guarded writer's precondition IS the law expression (scripts/bench_proofs.py:40-41), so the proof shows the pipeline catches the unguarded mutant, not that an ERP writer enforces the clause. Pointwise clause only; referenced original quantities must be resolved faithfully. No writer induction or ERPNext parity claim.

rules.requirement: Disallow negative stock by item, warehouse and posting time
rules.limit: decision.guard_false per holding; backdated posting-time recomputation is not covered.

rules.requirement: Issue stock using the oldest eligible cost layers
rules.limit: Ordered-fold rule in the declared writer.

rules.requirement: Value an issue at the prior moving average
rules.limit: Ordered-fold rule in the declared writer.

rules.requirement: A serial number cannot be held in two warehouses
rules.limit: Declared key on the object; surfaces as decision.host (SQLite UNIQUE), not a stable core refusal code.

rules.requirement: Do not deliver an expired batch
rules.limit: action.precondition_failed on the declared writer only; laws cannot read slices.

rules.requirement: A stock transfer preserves quantity across both locations
rules.limit: Seal-time coefficient check covers every declared parameter value of a quantity template. The declared REA transfer writer is not a sealed template; that path has runtime correspondence only.

rules.requirement: Stock value changes agree with inventory GL postings
rules.limit: law.model.predicate_type: expr.variable.unknown, `slice` is not a variable of the law environment. One declared writer posts both sides atomically, but no law can state the correspondence.

rules.requirement: Every journal balances debits and credits per company/book/currency
rules.limit: Shared commit check per scope, book, graph, journal and unit.

rules.requirement: Journal entry accounts match company and currency settings
rules.limit: action.precondition_failed on the declared writer only.

rules.requirement: Refuse postings in a closed accounting period
rules.limit: action.precondition_failed on the declared writer only; closure over all posting writers is not established.

rules.requirement: Cancellation appends reversals instead of deleting ledger entries
rules.limit: PostedJournalImmutable and JournalDeleteForbidden in the commit check.

rules.requirement: Cannot cancel a document with outstanding dependent documents
rules.limit: Bounded link slice read; action.precondition_failed on the declared writer only.

rules.requirement: Round invoice totals using configured precision and rounding method
rules.limit: round() needs a literal scale and mode, so configured scale cannot be read; the method is selected from a configured enumerated value.

rules.requirement: Approval author must have the required role on this revision
rules.limit: Revision binding is a precondition; role comes from the authorization seam.

rules.requirement: Editing an approved amount invalidates its approval
rules.limit: core.laws.violated for a retained approval whose stored approved_amount no longer matches. Proof unknown: only fixed-unit decimals supported.

rules.requirement: Value returned goods at their original delivery cost
rules.limit: action.precondition_failed on the declared writer only.

rules.requirement: Posting date must belong to an active fiscal year
rules.limit: action.precondition_failed on the declared writer only.

rules.requirement: Reconciliation adjustments preserve ledger history and account for variance
rules.limit: Bounded, one-create profile only (norn.bench.one-create/1: empty store, one object, one create step, numeric inputs in [-3, 4]). 3 of the law's 10 proof goals are eligible and discharged; the other 7 (law_semantics, open_boundary) stay unknown, so this is not a whole-law proof. The guarded writer's precondition IS the law expression (scripts/bench_proofs.py:40-41), so the proof shows the pipeline catches the unguarded mutant, not that an ERP writer enforces the clause. core.laws.violated plus writer precondition for the book quantity. Multi-ledger history comparison is not covered.
